sub_graphs.title: Homestead Block State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete state transition pipeline when processing a new block in Homestead

nodes.label: Block Received
nodes.description: A new block has been received and is ready for validation

nodes.label: Validate Header
nodes.description: Validate block header including parent hash, gas limit, timestamp, difficulty, and extra data (<=32 bytes)

nodes.label: Header Validated
nodes.description: Block header has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Validate Ommers
nodes.description: Validate uncle blocks: max 2, no duplicates, age 1-6 blocks, valid parent in recent canonical chain

nodes.label: Ommers Validated
nodes.description: All ommer blocks have passed validation checks

nodes.label: Apply Block Body
nodes.description: Execute all transactions in the block and apply state changes

nodes.label: Body Applied
nodes.description: All transactions executed and state updated

nodes.label: Verify Root Hashes
nodes.description: Verify state root, transaction root, receipt root, and logs bloom match computed values

nodes.label: Block Validated and Applied
nodes.description: Block is fully validated and applied to the blockchain state

nodes.label: Block Invalid
nodes.description: Block failed validation - InvalidBlock exception raised

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: P2P network peer that submitted the block for validation

sub_graphs.title: Homestead Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models how transactions are validated and executed in Homestead

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction is pending processing within a block

nodes.label: Check Transaction
nodes.description: Validate: available gas, nonce match, balance >= gas*price + value, sender is EOA

nodes.label: Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction passed all pre-execution checks

nodes.label: Transaction Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction failed validation checks

nodes.label: Increment Sender Nonce
nodes.description: Increment the sender's account nonce by 1

nodes.label: Deduct Full Gas Fee
nodes.description: Deduct tx.gas * tx.gas_price from sender balance

nodes.label: Execute Message Call
nodes.description: Execute transaction via process_message_call()

nodes.label: Transaction Executed
nodes.description: Transaction execution complete (success or failure)

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Refund
nodes.description: Refund = min(gas_used/2, refund_counter)

nodes.label: Refund Unused Gas
nodes.description: Return gas_left * gas_price to sender

nodes.label: Pay Mining Fee
nodes.description: Transfer gas_used_after_refund * gas_price to coinbase

nodes.label: Create Receipt
nodes.description: Generate receipt with state root, cumulative gas, logs, bloom filter

nodes.label: Transaction Complete
nodes.description: Transaction fully processed with receipt generated

external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
external_entities.description: External account that signed and submitted the transaction

sub_graphs.title: Homestead Proof-of-Work Consensus
sub_graphs.description: Models the proof-of-work validation and difficulty adjustment in Homestead

nodes.label: Header Pending PoW Validation
nodes.description: Block header ready for proof-of-work verification

nodes.label: Generate PoW Header Hash
nodes.description: Hash header excluding nonce and mix_digest

nodes.label: Compute Hashimoto Light
nodes.description: Execute hashimoto_light() with cached dataset

nodes.label: Verify Mix Digest
nodes.description: Confirm mix_digest matches computed value

nodes.label: Verify Difficulty Target
nodes.description: Verify result <= MAX_VALUE / difficulty

nodes.label: PoW Valid
nodes.description: Proof-of-work validation passed

nodes.label: PoW Invalid
nodes.description: Proof-of-work validation failed

nodes.label: Calculate Block Difficulty
nodes.description: Apply difficulty formula with timestamp delta and difficulty bomb: 2^(block_number/100000 - 2)

nodes.label: Difficulty Computed
nodes.description: Target difficulty calculated for block

external_entities.name: Block Miner
external_entities.description: Miner that produced the block with valid proof-of-work

sub_graphs.title: Homestead Gas and Rewards
sub_graphs.description: Models gas limit adjustments and block reward distribution in Homestead

nodes.label: Gas Limit Check Required
nodes.description: Block gas limit needs validation against parent

nodes.label: Check Gas Limit
nodes.description: Verify gas_limit within parent +/- (parent/1024) and >= 5000

nodes.label: Gas Limit Valid
nodes.description: Gas limit within acceptable bounds

nodes.label: Gas Limit Invalid
nodes.description: Gas limit outside acceptable bounds

nodes.label: Block Finalized
nodes.description: Block has been fully processed, ready for reward distribution

nodes.label: Pay Block Reward
nodes.description: Miner receives 5 ETH + (5 ETH / 32) * ommer_count

nodes.label: Pay Ommer Rewards
nodes.description: Each ommer miner receives ((8 - ommer_age) * 5 ETH) / 8

nodes.label: Rewards Distributed
nodes.description: All block and ommer rewards have been paid

sub_graphs.title: Homestead Transaction Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the specific validation checks for transaction inclusion in Homestead

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Transaction waiting to be validated for block inclusion

nodes.label: Check Gas Available
nodes.description: Verify block_gas_limit - block_gas_used >= tx.gas

nodes.label: Check Nonce Match
nodes.description: Verify sender nonce matches account nonce exactly

nodes.label: Check Balance Sufficient
nodes.description: Verify sender balance >= tx.gas * tx.gas_price + tx.value

nodes.label: Check Sender is EOA
nodes.description: Verify sender account has no code (is externally owned)

nodes.label: Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks passed, transaction can be executed

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: Transaction rejected due to validation failure

ambiguities.text: The exact behavior when nonce mismatch occurs is not detailed - whether it's a temporary skip or permanent rejection
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nonce mismatch results in transaction rejection from the current block, not permanent ban. Transaction can be re-submitted with correct nonce.

ambiguities.text: The documentation states 'Only last 255 blocks retained' but also mentions 'clients store more for reorgs'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume protocol requires minimum 255 blocks for BLOCKHASH opcode, but implementations may retain more for chain reorganization handling.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethash PoW algorithm and DAG generation are cryptographically secure against pre-computation attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners could pre-compute valid PoW solutions, breaking the security model of block production

implicit_assumptions.description: Honest miners control sufficient hash power to prevent 51% attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could rewrite blockchain history, double-spend, or censor transactions

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge ECDSA signatures for accounts they do not control
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could impersonate any account and steal funds

implicit_assumptions.description: Block timestamps are reasonably accurate and increase monotonically
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Difficulty adjustment manipulation, potential consensus issues
